list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades from the official list on Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Guides are our own words, written for this entry from the official descriptions; where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

sources.label: Exophase — official GTA VI trophy list (names, descriptions, grades)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies and PSN progress targets

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task here — it is the reward for finishing everything else in this guide. Work the roadmap in order and this pops last. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the list make-up (1 platinum of 55). Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in this guide.
The platinum unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story mission, so it comes naturally at the start of the game — just follow the mission prompts until the mission-complete screen. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the story and play Gone Fishing through to the end.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are awarded for completing the story, so this cannot be missed — keep playing the story and it unlocks when the chapter ends. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it is awarded for completing the story and cannot be missed. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. A story-completion trophy: play through the chapter and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 story missions.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale — complete the chapter and it is yours. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 story missions.

trophies.guide: Play the story to its end and complete the final mission. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it marks the end of the story — it cannot be missed as long as you finish the game. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1–4, then complete the final mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in your mission list. Named-mission trophies unlock by finishing that mission, so play it through to the end. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Breakfast Run mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions usually have set-up steps before the main job — finish the whole mission chain and the trophy unlocks. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play The Cartel Heist mission chain to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Finish the mission as the story presents it and the trophy follows. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Child's Play mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the mission through — no extra objective is named in the official description. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Headliners mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the VCIA Takedown mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large set-piece mission — play it through to the end and the trophy is yours. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission to completion.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen — story, side missions, collectibles, activities and challenges all count toward it. This is the second gold trophy and the real endgame grind: use this guide's checklist to find what is left, and save it for last, just before the platinum. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story and all side content.
Check the in-game stats for what is still missing.
Clear the last items, then this unlocks.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like — anywhere in Leonida. The count is cumulative across the whole game, so it builds up naturally while you play; chase it deliberately late in the game by chaining jumps and stunt jumps. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 250 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Play normally — stunts count as you go.
Late game, chain stunt jumps to finish the last of the 250.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity once — racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the rest. You do not need to win or finish them, just try each kind once, so sample everything early and this pops quickly. The official description does not list the types, so work through the activities this guide covers. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one of each activity type: race, fish, shoot, drone race, arcade, bowl, meditate, hunt, and more.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and replay any challenge until the gold score lands. Visit the range between story missions so the practice is spread out. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 42 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find a Shooting Range and try each challenge.
Replay challenges below gold until all 42 are gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations across Leonida. Drone races reward tight lines and clean flying more than speed — learn each course's gates, then win one race per location. The official description does not name the locations, so explore the map for Top Fun markers. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 14 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location.
Win one race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so repeats of the same race do not help. Work through the race locations across Leonida, one win each, and keep a note of which you have won. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 20 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races at different locations.
Win 20 different ones; repeats do not count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so watch Cal's catch rate and focus on steady reeling rather than rushing — the challenge is won on the catch, not on speed. The official description does not say where Cal fishes, so look for the fishing challenge marker. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find the fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him to win the challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most and play it through — no high score is named in the official description. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade and start any game.
Play it through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Side-character strands unlock as you meet each character — keep taking Andy's missions when they appear until his last one is done. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand by completing his final mission. Work through Kenton's missions in order as they unlock. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Take Billy's missions whenever they show up and follow the strand to its end. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore — stop for them instead of driving past, and finish each strand you start. Eight strands is a big chunk of side content, so spread it across the game. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 8 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Explore Leonida and stop at stranger markers.
Complete 8 full stranger strands.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand by completing his final mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and follow the strand through. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand by completing his final mission. Work through Tyrone's missions in order until the last one is done. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places scattered around the map — visit each one and meditate there. The official description does not list the spots, so explore the map and mark each one off as you find it. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 18 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Explore Leonida for meditation spots.
Meditate at all 18 of them.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This is a hunting task tied to a specific animal — follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, then track the animal and take it down. The official description does not name the animal or the place, so let Bret's missions lead you there. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Follow Bret's strand to the hunt.
Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — collect full sets, and three complete sets earns the silver. This is a long collectible hunt, so pick cards up as you travel rather than leaving them all for the endgame. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 3 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Complete 3 full card sets.

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-sharing app, so this means visiting 100 different spots and sharing a snap from each — a sightseeing trophy that rewards exploring the whole map. Tick locations off as you travel for other trophies. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Visit varied locations across Leonida.
WAiNK It at 100 different spots.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives — driving, combat, exploration and more — and they stack up across everything you do. Check the challenges list in-game, clear the easy ones first, and the count grows on its own. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 50 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the in-game challenges list.
Complete any 50 challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. This is a partner moment — it needs the two of you together, so try it during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is with you, and break line of sight until the wanted level clears. It can be missed if you finish the partner sections without attempting it, so try it early. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner alongside you.
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the chain breaks if the wanted level drops between robberies, so plan a route of three nearby shops and move fast between them. Another partner moment: attempt it while your partner is with you, before those sections end. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Play with your partner alongside you.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back, keeping your wanted level throughout.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive, ride or find them across Leonida and each new one counts. Variety helps: try different districts, vehicle classes and parked cars rather than driving the same car all game. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 100 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Drive and find new vehicles as you explore.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when they are close together, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Missions with clustered enemies are the best place to try. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with 5+ enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave the airport by air without a scheduled flight. This is a one-spot stunt: get to VCIA, find a plane, and take off on your own terms. It is flagged missable because it is tied to a single location and moment — try it on your first airport visit. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport).
Take off in a plane without a scheduled flight.

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not a checklist, so the exact trigger is not pinned down by the official list: expect a Rhino encounter, whether stealing one, destroying one or surviving one. Try interacting with a Rhino tank when one appears and see what the game counts. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank in the game.
Interact with it — steal, destroy or survive it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: plan the entry, avoid cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave and try again, since robberies can be repeated. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vault jobs are the bigger heists — plan each robbery, grab the take and get clear before the law closes in. All five count cumulatively, so they can be spread across the game. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 5 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find bank vault robbery opportunities.
Rob 5 vaults and escape each time.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — hit one, take the cash and break away before the police catch up. One clean robbery is all it takes. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob it and escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map — the game tracks which areas you have visited, so cover the cities, the countryside and the coast. Mop this up at the end by visiting any areas your map still shows as unexplored. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 52 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through every district of Leonida.
Visit all 52 areas.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida — find one per gang, hit it and get out. The official description does not name the gangs or their turf, so learn them from the world as you play. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 9 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Learn which gangs hold which operations.
Rob one illegal operation per gang — all 9.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar or spot with a view, and order a cocktail. A relaxing one — no combat, just the beach. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Enjoy a cocktail with a view.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street. Pick a showroom, get in a car inside it, and floor it through the front. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and get in a car.
Smash out through the front in the car.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — bowl a full game there. The name suggests a proper follow-through on your throw, so play a game at that specific alley rather than any other. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game there.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the official list pins nothing else down. Expect a moment where you and your partner do something the public notices: play the partner sections and watch for a crowd or public reaction. Flagged missable because it is tied to a single partnership moment. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play through the partner sections.
Watch for a public, crowd-facing partnership moment.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Choices appear all through the game, in dialogue, missions and the open world, so this builds up over a full playthrough. There is no way to rush it: keep making choices and it lands late in the game. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 500 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them.
Keep going — 500 choices across a full playthrough.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt. The description points at a retry, so if you fail a challenge, mission objective or minigame, try it again right away instead of moving on. Flagged missable because the moment is a single retry. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a challenge or objective once.
Succeed at the same thing on your next try.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplainable moment. The description gives no location, so this is one to stumble on while exploring: keep an eye out for strange sights across Leonida, especially at night or off the beaten path. Flagged missable because a one-off strange event may not repeat. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida, including odd corners and night-time spots.
Witness the strange event when it happens.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Find a quiet stretch of road, pick up speed, and swing as you pass. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and land a melee drive-by.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the game. Robberies feed this trophy, so it pairs well with the vault and truck jobs. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $250,000 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect marked bills from robberies.
Launder $250,000 through your contacts.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, cars, anything the shops sell. Spending counts cumulatively, so buy what you need as you play and top up with big purchases late in the game if you are short. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the $100,000 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Shop as you play — every purchase counts.
Spend $100,000 in total across all shops.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought around Leonida as you earn money — buy each one when you can afford it, and the trophy unlocks with the last purchase. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 8 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Earn money through missions and jobs.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, then register each one in the app — ten registrations earns the trophy. Source: the official list on Exophase for the name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the 10 target. Our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find vehicles worth keeping.
Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
